en: The postcard shows a uniformed guard from the Austro-Hungarian era standing in front of a sentry box beside a stone building. The guard is dressed in a formal dark blue uniform with gold epaulettes, white gloves, and a tall bearskin hat. There is a public notice on the wall beside him. The caption at the bottom reads 'Die Grazer Burgwache im Kriegsjahre 1914,' and there is a date and signature in the bottom right corner.
